cases.sentence: Дина, дочь Лии от Иакова, пошла навестить местных ___.
cases.translation: Dinah, Leah's daughter by Jacob, went out to visit the local women.
cases.explain: The transitive verb навестить takes its direct object in the accusative; for an animate plural the accusative equals the genitive form.

cases.sentence: Пусть живут в нашей ___ и торгуют в ней.
cases.translation: Let them live in our land and trade in it.
cases.explain: The preposition в indicating location takes the prepositional case.

cases.sentence: Его сыновья были в поле со ___.
cases.translation: His sons were in the field with the herds.
cases.explain: The preposition с (со) in the sense of 'together with' governs the instrumental case.

cases.sentence: Сыновья Иакова вернулись с ___, как только услышали о случившемся.
cases.translation: The sons of Jacob returned from the fields as soon as they heard what had happened.
cases.explain: The preposition с expressing motion 'from' governs the genitive case.

cases.sentence: Назначьте за ___ любой выкуп и подарки, и я заплачу.
cases.translation: Set for the bride any bride-price and gifts, and I will pay.
cases.explain: The preposition за in the sense of 'in exchange for' takes the accusative case.

cases.sentence: Отдать нашу сестру необрезанному ___ было бы для нас позором.
cases.translation: To give our sister to an uncircumcised man would be a disgrace to us.
cases.explain: The verb отдать (to give to someone) takes its indirect object in the dative case.

cases.sentence: Молодой человек без ___ исполнил то, что они сказали.
cases.translation: The young man without delay did what they had said.
cases.explain: The preposition без (without) governs the genitive case.

cases.sentence: Хамор и его сын Шехем пришли к ___ города и обратились к жителям.
cases.translation: Hamor and his son Shechem came to the gate of the city and addressed its inhabitants.
cases.explain: The preposition к (direction toward) governs the dative case (here a plurale tantum in the dative).

reading.ru: Дина, дочь Лии от Иакова, пошла навестить местных женщин.
reading.question: Why did Dinah go out?
options: To fetch water from the well
reading.explain: The text says she 'пошла навестить местных женщин' (went to visit the local women).

reading.ru: И Шехем сказал своему отцу Хамору, «Возьми мне эту девушку в жены».
reading.question: What did Shechem ask his father Hamor to do?
options: To get Dinah for him as a wife
To go to war with Jacob
reading.correct: To get Dinah for him as a wife
reading.explain: The text says 'Возьми мне эту девушку в жены' (Get me this young woman as a wife).

reading.ru: Тогда сыновья Иакова ответили Шехему и его отцу Хамору лживо, потому что он обесчестил их сестру Дину.
reading.question: How did Jacob's sons answer Shechem and Hamor?
reading.explain: The text says they 'ответили... лживо' (answered deceitfully).

reading.ru: Мы дадим согласие лишь при одном условии, если вы станете как мы и сделаете всем вашим мужчинам обрезание.
reading.question: On what condition would Jacob's sons agree?
options: That all their males be circumcised
That they pay a large dowry
reading.correct: That all their males be circumcised
reading.explain: The text says they would agree if 'сделаете всем вашим мужчинам обрезание' (you circumcise all your males).

reading.ru: Три дня спустя, когда они еще страдали от боли, двое сыновей Иакова, Симеон и Левий, братья Дины, взяли мечи, неожиданно напали на город и убили всех мужчин.
reading.question: What did Simeon and Levi do three days later?
options: They attacked the city and killed all the males
reading.correct: They attacked the city and killed all the males
reading.explain: The text says they 'напали на город и убили всех мужчин' (attacked the city and killed all the males).

reading.ru: Тогда Иаков сказал Симеону и Левию, вы навлекли на меня беду, сделали меня ненавистным для жителей этой земли, хананеев и ферезеев.
reading.question: How did Jacob respond to what Simeon and Levi had done?
options: He said they had brought trouble upon him
reading.correct: He said they had brought trouble upon him
reading.explain: The text says 'вы навлекли на меня беду' (you have brought trouble upon me).
